comment: BNpcBase 9020, the invisible helper retail used in several duties; here the Copperbell Mines' first boss's three (layout 9054923), which the director puts on Kottos' landing spots and has cast 28544 (w1d1_re.lua). 28544 never caught anyone in Bob's three runs (Chronofoil captures of 2026-10-25): its amounts are a stand-in, the boss's 28546's. No auto-attack, no timepoints: it acts only when the director says.
